description: Additional file content representation cases for empty and multiline Unicode plaintext.

cases.description: An empty plaintext file reports empty renderings and zero byte size.
Multiline Unicode plaintext preserves line breaks while reporting canonical base64 and byte size.
cases.expected_output:
encoding=plaintext
plain=alpha
βeta
emoji=🚀
base64=YWxwaGEKzrJldGEKZW1vamk98J+agA==

cases.expected_output:
encoding=base64
plain=こんにちは
base64=44GT44KT44Gr44Gh44Gv
